title.zh: New York Wants to Ban Polymarket, Lawsuit Calls It 'Illegal Gambling Operation'
title.en: New York Wants to Ban Polymarket, Lawsuit Calls It 'Illegal Gambling Operation'

current_state.zh: New York Attorney General Letitia James and Governor Kathy Hochul sued Polymarket, alleging it operates an illegal unlicensed gambling business, and are seeking to bar it from the state, recover gains, and impose treble-damage fines.
current_state.en: New York Attorney General Letitia James and Governor Kathy Hochul sued Polymarket, alleging it operates an illegal unlicensed gambling business, and are seeking to bar it from the state, recover gains, and impose treble-damage fines.
